text.en: Section 52 of the Judiciary Act (Republic Act No. 296, as amended) is hereby amended to read

Permanent Stations of District Judges. The permanent station of Judges of the Sixth Judicial
District shall be in the City of Manila.
In other judicial districts, the permanent stations of the judges shall be as follows:
For the First Judicial District, the judges of the first and fifth branches of the Courts of First Instance of
Cagayan and Batanes shall be stationed in the Municipality of Tuguegarao, Province of Cagayan; the judge of
the second branch, in the Municipality of Aparri, same province; the judge of the third branch, in the
Municipality of Tuao, same province; and the judge of the fourth branch in the Municipality of Sanches Mira,
same province; one judge shall be stationed in the Municipality of Ilagan, Province of Isabela; one judge shall
be stationed in the Municipality of Cabagan, same province; one judge shall be stationed in the Municipality
of Cauayan, same province; the judge of the fourth branch shall be stationed in the Municipality of Roxas,
same province; the judge of the fifth branch shall be stationed in the Municipality of Echague, same province;
three judges, in the Municipality of Bayombong, Province of Nueva Vizcaya; and one judge in the
Municipality of Cabarroguis, Province of Quirino.
For the Second Judicial District, four judges (Branches I, II, III and VI) shall be stationed in the City of
Laoag, one judge (Branch V) to be stationed in the Municipality of Bangui, Province of Ilocos Norte; one
judge (Branch IV) shall be stationed in the Municipality of Batac, same province; three judges (Branches I,
III, and VI) in the Municipality of Vigan, Province of Ilocos Sur; one judge (Branch V) in the Municipality of
Cabugao, same province; one judge (Branch II) in the Municipality of Narvacan, same province; one judge

Section 2. All provisions of existing laws, orders, rules and regulations, contrary to or inconsistent with the
provisions of this Decree are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
Section 3. This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-three.
